description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.005 USDC per call via x402] Normalise contact lists before they go into a CRM or a mail/SMS tool: emails (trimmed, display names and mailto: removed, domain lower-cased, syntax checked, typo domains like gmial.com flagged with a suggestion, role inboxes and disposable domains flagged) and phone numbers to E.164 (+14805550123; North American numbers checked against the numbering plan, others by shape, extensions kept). Duplicates that differ only in formatting are grouped. Up to 10000 of each. Deterministic, no lookups.

defaultCallingCode.description: country calling code for numbers written without one, e.g. "1" (US/Canada, default) or "44" (UK)

name: contact_normalize
title: Clean and dedupe emails and phone numbers (E.164)
